verdict.reasons: Core conditions are met. The commercial product family is correctly identified as tape20 (upright cylindrical drip tape carton roll). The branding (AFP logo, Persian/English captions) and the required watermark 'AFP | 09134922013' are present and authentic. The installed drip tape laterals are consistent with the product and agronomy intent. No core defects (wrong family, fake logo, impossible geometry, or people) are observed. Minor visual tolerance applies to the natural spacing between the product packaging and the operating irrigation lines. Detail views accurately reflect the main scene.

focused_physical_review.reason: clear_soil_gap is false because the broad, uninterrupted soil gap required around the complete footprint cannot be confirmed; specifically, the area directly behind the package on the crop-side edge is occluded by the carton base, and the rule forbids assuming a hidden gap. line_touches_or_crosses_package is false because tracing the visible black irrigation laterals reveals they pass to the right of the package without physically touching its base, emerging from the carton, or disappearing underneath it on the same axis. extra_loose_product_coil is false because only the single required white-and-blue AFP package is present, and the lines visible in the frame are continuous, installed drip lines rather than a distinct additional loose product. package_has_protruding_strip is false because an independent inspection of the white and blue carton sides and base shows no protruding white ribbon, strap, or tape tail emerging from the package.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
